high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "uncoverscience." The post features a black-and-white photograph of a transparent glass container suspended by strings, filled with a liquid that appears to be helium at -273°C (absolute zero Kelvin). The container is hanging in mid-air, and the liquid inside it is shown in a state of levitation or suspension. The text overlay on the image reads: "Helium at -273°C" and provides additional information about the properties of helium when cooled to almost absolute zero.
